headline: On October 9, 2012: Pakistani Taliban attempt to assassinate Malala Yousafzai
captionCards: Youngest Nobel Peace Prize laureate at age 17
instagramCaption:
Malala Yousafzai survived a targeted attack by the Pakistani Taliban in her native Swat district. The group had previously banned girls from attending school in the region. This act of violence against the education activist sparked an international movement for women's rights. Her advocacy transformed her into Pakistan's most prominent citizen according to former prime minister Shahid Khaqan Abbasi. She later became the youngest Nobel Prize laureate in history at age 17.
